entries.name: Bio-protocol
entries.role: Peer-reviewed life-science protocol journal; individual articles carry per-article copyright terms

entries.name: Wet Lab Protocols (WLP)
entries.role: Fine-grained span and action-graph annotated wet-lab protocol corpus used in assayfold and lab-ears

entries.name: BioPlanner (BioProt)
entries.role: Automatic evaluation benchmark for translating biology protocol goals into structured pseudocode functions
entries.contamination_warning: Held-out planning benchmark; exclude evaluation splits from L3 post-training.

entries.name: BioProBench
entries.role: Multi-task biological protocol benchmark aligned with assayfold (`CC-BY-NC-4.0`, non-commercial)
entries.contamination_warning: Non-commercial held-out benchmark; never ingest into commercial pipelines or L3 training.

entries.name: LAB-Bench
entries.role: FutureHouse biology research evaluation suite including ProtocolQA, LitQA2, DbQA, and CloningScenarios
entries.contamination_warning: Contains benchmark canary strings; strictly eval_only — never train on LAB-Bench splits.

entries.name: FineBio
entries.role: Multi-view egocentric and third-person video dataset of wet-lab biological experiments with hierarchical atomic-action, object, and step annotations (CVPR 2024 / IJCV 2025)
entries.contamination_warning: Signed non-commercial research license agreement required for video/annotation access; exclude FineBio splits from autonomous training corpora.
entries.record_count: 32 participants across 7 molecular biology protocols (egocentric + 5 third-person cameras)

entries.name: ChemBench
entries.role: Automated chemistry, analytical spectroscopy, materials, and lab-safety reasoning benchmark suite (Nature Chemistry 2025)
entries.contamination_warning: Contains benchmark canary strings and strict evaluation-only notice; never ingest ChemBench splits into L3 post-training or pretraining.
entries.record_count: 2,700+ expert-curated chemistry and materials question-answer items

entries.name: BixBench
entries.role: FutureHouse agentic computational biology and bioinformatics evaluation suite over real-world research analysis capsules (2025)
entries.contamination_warning: Held-out agentic bioinformatics benchmark (companion to LAB-Bench); strictly eval_only — exclude all capsules and questions from L3 training.
entries.record_count: 205 multi-step questions derived from 60 real-world analysis capsules

entries.name: MassSpecGym
entries.role: Tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) molecular discovery, retrieval, and de novo structure generation benchmark with Murcko-Histamine splits (NeurIPS 2024)
entries.contamination_warning: Preserve Murcko-Histamine scaffold-disjoint evaluation splits; never fit models on held-out test MS/MS spectra.
entries.record_count: 231,000+ curated MS/MS spectra across ~29,000 unique molecules

entries.name: Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset (MSD)
entries.role: Aligned 1H-NMR, 13C-NMR, HSQC-NMR, FTIR, and positive/negative MS/MS molecular structure elucidation corpus from IBM rxn4chemistry (NeurIPS 2024)
entries.record_count: 790,000 reaction-derived molecules with aligned NMR, FTIR, and MS/MS spectra

entries.name: AqSolDB
entries.role: Curated experimental aqueous solubility reference set and RDKit 2D descriptor corpus grounding self-driving lab formulation and lab-decide calibration
entries.record_count: 9,982 unique compounds standardized across 9 experimental solubility datasets

entries.name: CALiSol-23
entries.role: Experimental non-aqueous Li-ion electrolyte ionic conductivity atlas across lithium salts and solvents for autonomous battery formulation (Scientific Data 2024)
entries.record_count: 13,825 experimental ionic conductivity measurements (38 solvents, 14 lithium salts)

entries.name: Crystallography & Raman Open Databases (COD / ROD)
entries.role: Public-domain peer-reviewed CIF crystal structures and companion Raman spectra grounding XRD phase identification and lab-attrib NNLS deconvolution
entries.record_count: 520,000+ peer-reviewed CIF crystal structures (COD) and companion CC0 Raman spectra (ROD)

entries.name: Open Materials 2024 (OMat24)
entries.role: Meta FAIR large-scale non-equilibrium inorganic crystal structure, DFT energy, force, and stress corpus for autonomous solid-state discovery (2024)
entries.record_count: 118M+ DFT single-point inorganic crystal structure calculations

entries.name: DCASE Task 2 Machine Audio (2024-2026)
entries.role: First-shot and noise-aware unsupervised anomalous sound detection audio benchmark across industrial and robotic mechanisms grounding L2 lab-ears
entries.contamination_warning: Non-commercial CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 audio corpus; block from commercial training and isolate challenge evaluation clips from autoencoder fitting.
entries.record_count: 16+ machine types (RoboticArm, 3DPrinter, Gearbox, Valve, Pump, Fan, Bearing, Slide rail)

entries.name: DROID
entries.role: Large-scale in-the-wild 7-DoF robot manipulation trajectory dataset with calibrated stereo wrist and exterior RGB-D streams grounding L1 lab-hands (RSS 2024)
entries.record_count: 76,000 demonstration trajectories (350 hours across 564 scenes and 86 tasks)
